target.purpose: Preserve a fail-closed causal record for consequential operational actions without conflating provenance with authorization or writeback.
target.central_bottleneck: Operational actions become difficult to audit or safely compose when causal ancestry, side-effect evidence, and exact committed content are not bound into one verifiable lineage structure.
success: Every non-root action has at least one existing causal parent.
Side-effect nodes carry explicit attestation metadata.
Committed payload history cannot be changed through caller-owned mutable objects.
Lineage fingerprints bind exact reachable node content and topology.
Depth and parent fan-in remain explicitly bounded.

invariants: duplicate identities and duplicate parents refuse
lineage fingerprints bind content and topology
graph depth and fan-in are bounded

donor_plan.basis: The repository already owns the implemented causal-provenance mechanism; sibling authority and writeback systems remain separate composition targets.

nonclaims: not a production Palantir lineage service
attestation metadata is not externally authenticated
no exercised integration with the authority or writeback sibling repositories
